meta.title: 什么样的老板不值得跟？重点看他给不给你分钱

scenes.title_en: The key: do they share the money
scenes.context: 讲者指出判断老板的重点不是态度，而是给不给你分钱和机会。
sentences: 打你骂你不是重点，PUA你也不是重点。
Scolding or PUA-ing you isn't the point.
PUA：gaslighting
重点是给不给你分钱，因为你出来工作干嘛的？挣钱的对吧。
The real point is whether they share the money — you work to earn, right?
分钱：share the money
世界是动态的，如果你用静态的观点去看一个老板，那就太笨了。
The world moves. Judging a boss with a static view is just naive.
静态的观点：a static view
paraphrase: 态度是干扰项，分钱是硬标准
Attitude is noise; money is the signal.
Don't judge with a frozen snapshot.
scenes.speak: Scolding or PUA-ing you isn't the point. The real point is whether they share the money — you work to earn, right? The world moves. Judging a boss with a static view is just naive.

scenes.title_en: Ask for it; what you expect tends to come true
scenes.context: 讲者强调要主动伸手要钱要机会，坦诚沟通，心念会变成现实。
sentences: 你不伸手要，别人为什么要给你呢？
If you never ask, why would anyone hand it to you?
伸手要：ask for it
有什么需求你就要说出来，有什么想法你就要讲出来。
State your needs and voice your ideas openly.
坦诚沟通：open communication
言出法随，你想什么就会实现什么。
What you keep thinking tends to come true — your expectations shape reality.
言出法随：expectations shape reality
paraphrase: Not asking reads as not wanting.
Whatever you expect, you tend to get.
scenes.speak: If you never ask, why would anyone hand it to you? State your needs and voice your ideas openly. What you keep thinking tends to come true — your expectations shape reality.

scenes.context: 讲者讲贵人相助的本质是意识点拨与争取机会，主张自己变强并管理好老板。
sentences: 你只要坚持一点点，这个世界就会往你倾斜一点点。
Push just a little harder and the world leans your way a little more.
往你倾斜：lean your way
贵人相助，很多时候是意识层面的点拨，给你一个机会。
A mentor's help is usually a mindset shift — they hand you an opportunity.
意识点拨：a mindset shift
你自己强，比所有东西都重要，你去管理好他，让他为你服务。
Your own strength matters most — manage your boss well and make him serve you.
管理老板：manage your boss
paraphrase: Your growth is driven by you.
scenes.speak: Push just a little harder and the world leans your way a little more. A mentor's help is usually a mindset shift — they hand you an opportunity. Your own strength matters most — manage your boss well and make him serve you.

practice: Let's be open about what we each need.
I'd like to take on the core work — can we share it?
Push a little harder and things start to lean your way.
Manage your boss so he works for your growth.
pitfalls: ✓ 地道说法：My boss gaslights me.
PUA 是网络梗，英文对应 gaslight。
✕ 直译腔：I want to say out my needs.
✓ 地道说法：State your needs openly.
✕ 直译腔：Words come true as I say them.
✓ 地道说法：Your expectations tend to shape reality.
✕ 直译腔：A noble person helps me.
✓ 地道说法：A mentor gives you a leg up.
贵人→mentor；相助→give you a leg up。
footer_notes: ASR 校正：「PVPVA」校正为「PUA」、「做成大帅」校正为「做成大事业」、「通城目标」校正为「共同目标」、「生子相亲」校正为「升职加薪」、「有头在挖我」校正为「猎头在挖我」、「假很帅」校正为「假清高」、「打斩」校正为「打杂」、「买载票」校正为「买彩票」、「交地范围」校正为「交际范围」、「要心」校正为「野心」。
